posts.title: What I learned at LaravelDay 2026
posts.description: I spent a day at LaravelDay 2026 in Verona. Here is what I learned from the talks, why I think going to conferences is worth it, and why PHP is still alive.

posts.title: Passing tests do not make an AI-built app safe
posts.description: Researchers found AI-built apps handing private data to visitors who never logged in. Tests that only ask as the owner would not catch that. Here is the test that would.

posts.title: My Claude Code Output Style Needed Tests
posts.description: I wanted Claude Code to talk in a playful voice, so I built an output style. Then I wrote tests for the prompt, and they found bugs I could not see.
